subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of preparing a Manufacturing Account?
options: To calculate the gross profit realized on the sale of manufactured goods
To determine the net profit or loss for the entire business operations
To ascertain the cost of goods manufactured (cost of production) during the period
To classify assets and liabilities into their respective factory departments
questions.explain: A **Manufacturing Account** is an internal financial statement used specifically by manufacturing concerns. Its primary purpose is to calculate the total cost incurred in producing the goods during a period, known as the **Cost of Production** or Cost of Goods Manufactured, before these goods are transferred to the Trading Account.
